source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (public snapshot, mirrored by benchlm.ai)
notes: aa_intelligence is the published index score at as_of. Scores drift; refresh the snapshot rather than trusting stale numbers forever. Models absent from the snapshot carry score null and an explicitly assumed tier with provenance in note. Tier is derived from score via tier_bounds unless explicitly overridden. The bare names opus, sonnet, fable and haiku are aliases for the models Claude Code gave those names on 2026-10-06. verify_seconds, where present, is what this plugin's own benchmark timed for one verification; the selector prefers the fastest timed model that clears the floor. scales lists the versions of the index the scores were read from, newest first; a row with no scale is on the last one, and two scores are compared only within one version (across versions the selector compares tiers, then prefers the newer version, and says so). ranks_above, on a model with no score, names the listed model it is placed just above when candidates are ranked by capability: an assumption, with its provenance in note, to be dropped when the index lists the model.

models.note: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2, read 2026-10-06 (variant: Max). The rows without a note are the 2026-08-02 snapshot of an earlier version of the index: compare tiers across them, not scores.
